description: DB-backed: on a migrated schema, amending the declaration of the current checkpoint with a note kept and two citations (an interaction and an attached document) leaves opportunities.stage unchanged, publishes no OPPORTUNITY_STAGE_CHANGED event, keeps exactly one active user_declared row for the checkpoint, stores both citations in order, and the replacement row has the original recorded_at and recorded_by while the superseded row carries the editor in corrected_by

DB-backed guard: amending or declaring with an interaction from another opportunity, a document not attached to the deal, a source in another tenant, or a quote ref is refused and writes nothing, including when a valid citation is in the same request; more than 25 citations is refused; a repeated (type, id) is stored once

DB-backed: amendDeclaration refuses a checkpoint with no active evidence and the won checkpoint; on a checkpoint reached only by system evidence it inserts one user_declared row beside the system row; it succeeds on a closed opportunity

Engine: patch semantics. Note undefined keeps the note while citations change; citations undefined keeps citations while the note changes; null note and empty citations clear; identical content writes nothing; declareStage with no note stores a NULL detail, not the placeholder

DB-backed: declareStage with no content on a checkpoint that has a cited declaration, and completing a step tied to that checkpoint, both leave the declaration's note and citations as they were; completing a step on a checkpoint with no declaration seeds one with the step title

Migration: on a schema seeded with a pre-existing user_declared row carrying ref_type 'document', a corrected one carrying 'interaction', a system row carrying 'quote' and a placeholder-note row, the backfill produces one citation each for the two user rows and nulls their refs, leaves the system row's ref alone, nulls only the exact placeholder note, and running it twice changes nothing more

Ladder: getOpportunityDetail returns the declaration with its note and citations in position order with labels; deleting the interaction and detaching the document turns each into missing with a null label and the ladder still renders every rung

Dialog component: in edit mode it is prefilled with the note and two sources; removing one source, adding another from the grouped picker and saving submits the note with the new source list; a rejected source lookup still lets the note be saved; declare mode submits note and sources together

Timeline component: a reached current-stage rung renders the note, two source links and the Edit evidence control while its circle is not a button; clicking a link calls the open handler with the right type and id; a missing source renders the 'Source removed' badge; an unreached rung and the Identified rung render no Edit evidence control

Cited document viewer: with the cross-feature getDocument returning the document, the viewer opens it without calling getDocumentsByEntity; a permission error or missing document closes without rendering

REST integration: PUT declarations/{checkpoint} amends and returns the opportunity, 409 on an unreached checkpoint, 403 without opportunity update; POST evidence accepts citations, still accepts refType and refId alone, and answers 400 when both forms are sent; GET evidence lists citations

Contract checks: every msp/opportunities locale file has the new keys; the tenant table manifest and tenant deletion order include opportunity_evidence_citations ahead of opportunity_evidence; the generated OpenAPI and registries are in sync with the route definitions; the drafting prompt shows a fallback for a NULL note
